We need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <=9999. We need to find templates. Use search with list. Let's search for sulfonamide formation (sulfonyl chloride + amine). Also maybe amide formation, Wittig for C=C, etc.

We can break the target into fragments: It's a sulfonamide linking two aromatic rings: a tolyl (para-methyl phenyl) attached to sulfonyl group attached to another phenyl bearing a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall could be assembled via sulfonyl chloride coupling with an aniline, and amide formation via coupling of aniline with acryloyl chloride? Actually the amide is C(=O)N attached to phenyl (aniline) and conjugated to C=C attached to phenyl sulfonyl group.

Simplify retrosynthesis: Disconnection 1: Break sulfonamide bond: target -> sulfonyl chloride (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride) + aniline (the other aromatic with the unsaturated amide). So step 1: sulfonyl chloride + aniline -> sulfonamide via sulfonylation (template). Leaves: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (commercial?) and the other fragment.

Fragment B: Cc1ccc(SO2)?? Actually the other fragment is phenyl with para substituent: /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N. That's an anilide attached to cinnamoyl amide. Could be formed by amide coupling of aniline (c3ccccc3N) with trans-cinnamoyl chloride (or acryloyl derivative). Actually the fragment is phenyl (c2ccc) attached to C=C-CO-NH-Ph-NH2? Wait structure: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. So phenyl ring with para substituent: a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide where the amide nitrogen is attached to an aniline (c3ccccc3N). So we have an aniline (anilide) attached to a cinnamoyl group (trans). So we could disconnect the amide bond: give cinnamic acid (or its activated form) + aniline (c3ccccc3N). So step 2: amide formation.

Thus overall route: Step 1: sulfonylation of aniline (fragment B) with p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride. Step 2: amide formation of fragment B's aniline with cinnamic acid chloride.

Thus we need three steps max: maybe also need to prepare cinnamic acid (commercial) and p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (commercial). Leaves: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride, aniline (c3ccccc3N), cinnamic acid (or cinnamoyl chloride). All are commercially available and cheap.

We need to verify templates: sulfonylation (sulfonyl chloride + amine). amide formation (acid chloride + amine). Also maybe need to protect the aniline? But the aniline is part of final product (the second aniline). It will be used as nucleophile for amide formation, then later as part of sulfonamide? Actually the final product has two nitrogens: sulfonamide nitrogen attached to p-tolyl sulfonyl group, and the amide nitrogen attached to aniline (c3ccccc3N). The aniline is free NH2 attached to phenyl (c3ccccc3N). In final product, that aniline is attached to carbonyl (amide) and also has free NH2? Wait the SMILES: ...C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N. So the amide nitrogen is attached to phenyl which also has an NH2 substituent (aniline). So the fragment B includes an aniline that is not protected. So we need to form amide with that aniline's NH (the one attached to phenyl). That is possible using acid chloride and the aniline's NH (the free NH). The other NH (the sulfonamide) is separate.

Thus route: Starting materials: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (commercial), 4-aminobenzaldehyde? Actually we need the phenyl with para substituent of cinnamoyl amide and also an NH2 at para? Wait the phenyl ring (c2ccc) is attached to sulfonyl group at para? Actually the sulfonyl attaches to that phenyl at para position relative to the substituent? The SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1. So first phenyl (tolyl) has sulfonamide attached at para position. The sulfonyl attaches to second phenyl (c2ccc) at its para position relative to the cinnamoyl amide substituent. So the second phenyl is unsubstituted except for the sulfonyl at one position and the cinnamoyl amide at para. So we need that second phenyl (p-phenyl) with both substituents. Could be built by sulfonylation of that phenyl (which already has the cinnamoyl amide). So we need the phenyl with the cinnamoyl amide (and an aniline). That could be synthesized by amide formation on 4-aminophenyl (para-aminophenyl) with cinnamoyl chloride, giving p-aminophenyl cinnamamide (the aniline is free). Then sulfonylate the aniline (the other NH) with p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride to give final product. That is two steps: amide formation then sulfonylation. That's within 3 steps.

Thus leaves: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride, 4-aminophenyl (p-aminophenyl) (i.e., aniline), and cinnamoyl chloride (or cinnamic acid). Actually we need cinnamoyl chloride to react with aniline to give amide. Cinnamoyl chloride is commercially available. So leaves: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride, p-aminophenyl (aniline), cinnamoyl chloride. All cheap.

Now we need to construct JSON route.

We need template IDs for sulfonylation and amide formation. We need to search for templates.

Search for sulfonylation: functional_groups_formed: sulfonamide. Use list.
